headline: Discussed delinquent loans, a possible loan for Ponty Wellness, and two proposed subcommittees; no votes were recorded.
summary: The meeting covered the facade improvement program, delinquent loans, and a resignation from the board. A proposal to create two subcommittees and a possible loan for Ponty Wellness were also discussed. No votes or decisions were recorded.
plain_text:
Pawtucket Business Development Corporation (PBDC) 
PBDC Monthly Meeting 
Date: 08/11/2026 
100 Freight Street, Pawtucket, RI 02860 
 
Meeting called to ORDER 
President Scott Rotondo called the meeting to order at 4:19 pm 
Roll Call completed. Quorum achieved 
MEMBERS PRESENT (7): Scott Rotondo, Matthew Carvalho, Marcos Ribeiro, Irene Santos, 
Isaac Amponsah, Lindsey Ramirez, and John Neary.  
MEMBERS ABSENT (4): Lindsey Ramirez, Adalberto Perez, Ellen Matesanz, Minnie Luong. 
STAFF PRESENT (2): Sandra Mazo and Jean-Philippe Barros. 
Public Input:  
There was no public input 
 
Meeting Minutes - Meeting Minutes from June, 8, 2026 meeting will be approved during the next 
meeting. 
 
Financial Reports: 
In-house accounting reports 
John Neary gave the financial report and there were no material changes. Neary asked for the 
admin costs and is what is being waited on. 
 
Update on PBDC Spending:  
A different auditing firm is being sought for and the audit of the board is due in May.  
 
Old Business 
Facade Improvement Program 
Jean-Philippe Barros said there are five candidates in the pipeline and are in different sections 
of the progress. 
 
Delinquent Loan Update: 
Petro Lotus made a payment multiple months ago. Working Man Distillers has still not paid for 
the last six months. 
 
Collections: 
No updates from Tim Chapman. 
  
New Business 
Board Membership: 
Ellen Matesanz is resigning from the board. 
 
Create Two (2) Subcommittees: 
Scott Rotondo proposed creating two subcommittees, one related to gap funding and one 
related to business outreach. An idea of one pagers being sent out to businesses came about 
through this process. 
 
By Laws Discussion: 
Jean-Phillipe Barros will reach out to the city solicitor to find out if Matthew Carvalho can stay on 
the board if he wins his city council race in November.
Potential Loan: 
A loan for Ponty Wellness is working to be entertained as they are an infrared sauna business. 
 
Meeting was adjourned at 5:03 pm
